assessment: Alpha.604 fixes CoarseLocationUpdate incorrectly admitting fake visible remote 3D avatars before any real simulator avatar ObjectUpdate and overwriting high-precision, genuinely received avatar transforms with coarse map bytes. Full and Compressed avatar ObjectUpdate alone mark simulator_object_update_seen; map-only records and pre-object Low158/animation remain unverified and excluded from the 3D proxy path. WorldModel coarse snapshots no longer delete detailed avatars when absent, preserve actual appearance/outfit metadata and keep bounded map-only dots separately. Native test drives actual encoded coarse LLUDP payload through decode_coarse_location_update into WorldModel and tests real full-object precedence, duplicates, nil/self/invalid data and region invalidation; F7 counts ObjectUpdate-confirmed avatars and pure map dots separately. Authenticated real NexVerse own skin/COF/outfit and simulator-confirmed WASD end-to-end still open/unverified, weighted 38.65 percent (39 rounded).
